description:
List the user's stock portfolio holdings.

    Returns each position (shares, average cost, current price, market
    value, profit/loss, weight) from brokerage-linked and manually
    entered trades, plus totals. Use this when the user asks what they
    own or how their positions are doing. Don't use it for a public
    ticker the user doesn't own (use stock_analysis).

    Limits: requires sign-in. Prices are cached snapshots that can be up
    to 7 days old; positions without a price are labeled, never guessed.
    Users with no holdings yet see a demo portfolio, clearly labeled.
name: list_portfolio
title: List My Portfolio Holdings
